description: This PHP class defines the Contract model within the Goteo project, including properties, methods for creating, retrieving, validating, and managing contract data, as well as handling contract statuses and document types.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: A model class representing a legal or natural person contract within the Goteo crowdfunding platform, including properties for contract details, methods for managing contract lifecycle, validation, status updates, and document handling.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Overloaded getter to access properties, including a special case for 'fullnum' which combines contract number and date.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new contract record for a project, initializing data from project and user info, and saving it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a contract by project ID, including status and documents.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates contract data, checking required fields and document types.

methods.name: getValidation
methods.description: Calculates the completeness percentage of the contract data for publishing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the contract data to the database, either updating or inserting.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all contracts for management purposes.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Returns a list of projects that have filled out some contract information.

methods.name: getNum
methods.description: Retrieves the contract number and formatted date, or generates defaults if none exists.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a contract.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a contract, including date and user info.

methods.name: setPdf
methods.description: Updates the PDF filename associated with a contract.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs validation on required fields, populating errors and OK states.

methods.name: blankErrors
methods.description: Returns an initial empty structure for validation errors.

methods.name: txtInvest
methods.description: Generates a textual description of the project's funding objectives.

methods.name: txtReturn
methods.description: Generates a textual description of the project's collective returns.

methods.name: procStatus
methods.description: Returns an array of process statuses for contracts.

methods.name: procElectronicStatus
methods.description: Returns an array of electronic process statuses for contracts.

methods.name: procTransitionStatus
methods.description: Returns an array of transition statuses for contracts.

methods.name: nextStatus
methods.description: Provides the next possible statuses given the current status.

methods.name: getNaturalPersonDocumentTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of document types for natural persons.

methods.name: getLegalPersonDocumentTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of document types for legal entities.
